coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0) record: translational subset. Population is recurrent high-grade glioma grade 3 or 4 (WHO 2021) with glioblastoma named in conditions, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Temsirolimus given by super-selective intra-arterial infusion (or IV): formulation_flag new_route; catheter-based delivery not treated as device activation, device_dependent false. Eligibility requires mTOR pathway activation (PTEN loss, PI3K/AKT/mTOR alterations or pS6 IHC positivity), matched to the mTOR inhibitor temsirolimus. 'Patients who have completed the Stupp regimen' indicates recurrent disease after first-line therapy.
